methodology.contractors: Pre-rendered pages are a mix of the largest primes and socioeconomic firms (small business, 8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone). Everyone else in the index is searchable and links to USAspending.
methodology.awards: Up to eight of each profiled contractor's largest definitive contracts, delivery orders, and BPA calls with an action since Oct 1, 2019.
methodology.recompetes: Those awards with at least $1 million obligated and a current end date inside 18 months. Place of performance is the award's reported state, otherwise the contractor's address.
methodology.opportunities: Active SAM.gov notices, merged forward each day and capped so the file stays small.
